Austrian police are hunting two men alleged to have stolen a 200-carat platinum necklace encrusted with 673 diamonds that was on loan to a museum in Vienna and once belonged to Egyptian roya

articles.title: BitGo to buy NYDIG trading arm for $42.5M in cash and stock plus $15M earnout
articles.summary: The deal to buy NYDIG IF Holdings comprises $7 million in cash and around $35.5 million in stock, as well as the $15 earnout.

articles.title: Apple TV is raising its subscription prices again
articles.summary: Now, Apple TV subscriptions will cost $14.99 per month, up from its previous price of $12.99 per month.
